notes.title: Bermuda is officially on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/k4O0HMs.png[/img]

Hip! Hip! HURAAAYYY! 
After some trials, errors, and a lot of time--Bermuda has finally launched on Steam!

Now, before we jump head first into playing, I have a few important things to tell both old and new players!

[b]Important Note:[/b]

1. For those who have played the game before through lemmasoft or itch.io, some of your progress may be shown in the Steam version due to the persistent data files saved in your computer. You may find that the encyclopedia and CG gallery are pre-filled and your old save files may display. This can be solved by finding any Nusantara save files on your %APPDATA% RenPy folder and deleting them before installing the Steam version.

2. Through Beta testing on multiple Macbooks, I found out that Nusantara: Bermuda works alright on Macbook M1-M3! You might see a red ribbon saying "it may not open", but install it anyway and you'll see that you can play it just fine~

3. While Steam is still learning about this game, please be patient if there's an error or if the Achievement system is not working normally. It should unlock soon and if there's a problem, I will do my best to promptly fix it and post an update on the situation!

4. Bermuda will hold a 20% off launch discount on Steam for a week of celebreation--just like Winged Ones did before -^.^)/
Collected funds will be used for future projects development.

As always, thank you for your support, my lovely patrons/supporters ^///^ 
Let's continue to work hard together and look forward to my next project! I have a rough draft for the characters already (for 2 new ideas) and if things go smoothly, I will open a poll soon to vote which project I should do first!

xoxo,

SweetChiel
